in_sanskrit.name: नरहरि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: नरोऽर्हति हरिः (Naro'r Harih) - Hari, the protector of men.

in_hindi.name: नरहरी
in_hindi.long_meaning: नरों के शक्ति (Narōn ke śakti) - Power of men.

in_marathi.name: Narahari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the man-lion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narahari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Narahari is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nara' (man) and 'Hari' (Lord Vishnu). This name represents the form of Lord Vishnu who appears in the form of a man-lion. It is also a name of Lord Rama and Shiva.

This name represents the form of Lord Vishnu who appears in the form of a man-lion. It is also a name of Lord Rama and Shiva.
